app.name: Furniture Finder
onboarding.langHint: You can change this later in Settings.
onboarding.filesBody: Add the folders where you keep your Excel files. Sub-folders are included.
onboarding.dropTitle: Drag folders or Excel files here
onboarding.notExcel: Not a folder or an Excel file: {name}
onboarding.indexingBody: This happens only once. After that, changes are picked up by themselves.
onboarding.problemsTitle: Some files could not be read
onboarding.doneBody: {rows} rows from {files} files are ready to search.
onboarding.tip1Body: Write any part of a name or a code – in Hebrew, Arabic or English.
onboarding.tip2Title: Click a result to copy it
onboarding.tip2Body: The whole row is copied. Paste it into Excel or WhatsApp.
onboarding.tip3Body: Press and hold ⋯ and drag the bar anywhere on your screen.
onboarding.manageBody: These folders and files are searched. Changes are noticed by themselves.
onboarding.offlineHint: We keep searching the last copy until it is connected again.
errors.password: This file has a password. Remove the password in Excel, or leave this file out.
errors.corrupt: This file seems damaged, or it is not a real Excel file.
errors.unreadable: We could not open this file. It may have been moved or is blocked.
errors.tooBig: This file is too big to read.
bar.menuHint: More options – press and hold to move the bar
bar.hideNote: Press {hotkey} or click the icon near the clock to bring it back.
bar.moveHint: Drag the bar anywhere. Click or press Enter to place it. Esc to cancel.
bar.tryFewer: Try fewer words, or check the spelling.
bar.noFiles: No files yet. Add your Excel files to start.
settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithWindowsHint: The search bar is ready as soon as the computer starts.
settings.hotkey: Keyboard shortcut for the search bar
settings.hotkeyInvalid: Use Ctrl or Alt together with another key.
settings.showTray: Show an icon near the clock
settings.copyHeaders: When copying a row, include the column titles
settings.idleOpacity: Bar see-through when not in use
settings.autoWatch: Notice changes to my files automatically
settings.filesErrors: Files that could not be read
settings.noErrors: All files were read without problems.
settings.update.downloaded: The update is ready. It is installed when you restart.
settings.update.error: Could not check for updates. Is the internet connected?
settings.update.disabled: Updates are checked only in the installed app.
settings.privacy: Your files never leave this computer. Search works without internet.
